## Problem

Describe the defect, missing capability, or unclear guidance.

## Evidence

Provide upstream documentation, installed-version evidence, logs, or a minimal
reproduction.

## Changes

Summarize the files and behavior changed.

## Verification

List the exact commands run and results. State the highest verification level
reached and any skipped levels.

## Safety impact

Explain whether the change can affect motion, hardware, credentials, or command
execution. Include the test constraints used for safety-sensitive changes.
